scoring_guide.title: How Investment Guide scoring works
scoring_guide.intro: Point-sum shortlist for SP/SSP chip investment on mobile suits and pilots (Attack / Defense / Support). Units have separate SP and SSP boards; pilots use SP only. Criteria favor practical sortie tools (MAP, mobility follow-ups, weapon power) and a deep affinity pilot pool over a single linked recommend. Minor Attack stats (HP, SSP EN) are upside-only — no floor punishment. Close letters still need a human look.
overrides: Each axis adds points; the total becomes a letter, then a bucket (Recommended / Solid / Situational / Niche).
Filter by tag or Eternal Road Expert stage to compare units that actually fit the same restriction.
gaps: Non-Ultimate UR units are omitted from this guide for now — their kits are too unique for the shared SP/SSP criteria.
Ultimate units stay on the board. Their series Advantage: ability is withheld from the base score and only applied when a tag filter matches that Advantage series.
Letter cutoffs use separate scales for SP-eligible units/pilots vs Ultimate, so Ultimate kits do not lock out Recommended for chip investment targets.
Pilot recommended-MS points use this list's unit letters (SP/SSP best).
Strategic tag weights use how often tags appear on UR rosters (calibrated table).
Affinity pilot pool counts SSR+ pilots with piloting-tag / EX-pair affinity for the MS (not supporter amp %).
Pilot recommended-MS points only count units graded A / A+ / S / S+ on this guide (SP or SSP best) — B+ and below do not score.
Transform scores only when the alternate form unlocks deployable terrain, higher MOV, longer range, higher weapon power, or adds MAP.
Attack HP and SSP Attack EN are upside-only; Defense still taxes low HP/DEF. Special defenses (I-field / DR / barrier) are presence bonuses beyond the shield mechanism.
Units whose recommend pilot is UR/Ultimate take a mild −1 dependence tax (still usable with lower rarity pilots).
Close letters still need a human look.

criteria.title: Attack priorities
criteria.summary: Damage ceiling first (ATK + weapon power), then MOV/MAP. HP and SSP EN are upside-only — high is a bonus, low is not punished. MOB is a soft secondary.

criteria.title: Defense priorities
criteria.summary: High HP or DEF, a shield (~20% damage neglect), high MOV for support-defense coverage, solid terrain (Space + Land or Atmos), survivability kits (damage reduction / HP restore), plus a few good debuffs. ATK is upside only (≥9000). Special defenses (I-field / barrier / DR) are extra presence bonuses.

criteria.title: Debuffs (Defense / Support units)
criteria.summary: Attack units skip these axes. Debuff strength uses lasting DEF-down % or instant pierce (≈10%→3 … 40%+→6). Defense counts distinct debuff kinds at range ≥4 (light; damage-taken downs count as one kind). Support counts kinds at range ≥5 and cares more about strength.

criteria.title: MAP weapons (units)
criteria.summary: Damage MAP only (power ≥1) — non-damage MAPs like Live Concert Zaku are ignored. Presence for any damage MAP, extra for dash/MovingAttack, ammo 2+, and coverage (0–14 cells = 0, 15–24 = +1, 25+ = +2). Attack cap +4; Defense/Support cap +2.
